# Power

Raises a number to a power.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Power(value, exponent)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number to raise. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |
| `exponent` | number | The power to raise value to. A negative value with an exponent that is not an integer has no real result and is a runtime error. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. value raised to exponent; any number to the power 0 is 1. The result is exact when value is exact, exponent is an exact integer, and the result can be held exactly; otherwise the result is rounded to the nearest floating-point value. A result too large to hold, such as `Power(0, -1)`, is a runtime error. Never null.

## Example

`Power(2, 10)` returns `1024`.

`Power(9, 0.5)` returns `3`.
